title: Claude Haiku 4.5 bounded-autonomy full-profile campaign
research_question: How does Claude Haiku 4.5 behave across the complete incident corpus and all registered instruction profiles when every response action is mediated by CyberBroker?
hypothesis: Instruction profiles may change model conclusions and action requests, while CyberBroker prevents every policy-denied action from reaching a simulated tool.

conditions.description: Every model-requested response action is mediated by CyberBroker under policy version 0.1.

notes: Sequential exploratory campaign across all twelve incidents and all four registered profiles. Uses the pinned Claude Haiku 4.5 snapshot. All cells and failures are retained.
